questions.question: Which river is known as the "Sorrow of Bihar"?
questions.explanation: The Kosi river is called the "Sorrow of Bihar" due to flooding.

questions.question: Light travels fastest in:
questions.explanation: Light travels fastest in a vacuum (~3×10⁸ m/s).

questions.question: The Thar Desert is located mainly in which state?
questions.explanation: The Thar Desert lies mostly in Rajasthan.

questions.question: The Non-Cooperation Movement was launched by Gandhi in:
questions.explanation: The Non-Cooperation Movement began in 1920.

questions.question: A money bill can be introduced only in the:
questions.explanation: A money bill can be introduced only in the Lok Sabha.

questions.question: Which schedule of the Constitution deals with anti-defection?
questions.explanation: The 10th Schedule contains the anti-defection provisions.

questions.question: Who was the first woman Prime Minister of India?
questions.explanation: Indira Gandhi became PM in 1966.

questions.question: Which festival is known as the "Festival of Lights"?
questions.explanation: Diwali is the Festival of Lights.

questions.question: The Indus Valley Civilisation is also known as the:
questions.explanation: It is called the Harappan Civilisation after Harappa, its first excavated site.

questions.question: Which is the highest mountain peak entirely within India?
questions.explanation: Nanda Devi is the highest peak entirely within India.

questions.question: The capital of British India was shifted from Calcutta to Delhi in:
questions.explanation: The capital was shifted to Delhi in 1911.

questions.question: The "Right to Education" was made a fundamental right by which amendment?
questions.explanation: The 86th Amendment (2002) added Article 21A — Right to Education.

questions.question: Which is the smallest continent by area?
questions.explanation: Australia is the smallest continent.

questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution guarantees the Right to Constitutional Remedies?
questions.explanation: Article 32 is called the "heart and soul" of the Constitution.

questions.question: The "Gateway of India" is located in which city?
questions.explanation: The Gateway of India is in Mumbai.

questions.question: How many members can the President nominate to the Rajya Sabha?
questions.explanation: The President nominates 12 members to the Rajya Sabha for expertise in arts, science, etc.

questions.question: NABARD is associated primarily with:
questions.explanation: NABARD funds agriculture and rural development.

questions.question: Which disease is caused by a deficiency of iodine?
questions.explanation: Iodine deficiency causes goitre.

questions.question: Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.explanation: The Pacific is the largest and deepest ocean.

questions.question: In which year was the Reserve Bank of India established?
questions.explanation: The RBI was established in 1935.

questions.question: What is 20% of 80?
Find the simple interest on ₹1900 at 12% per annum for 4 years.
Find the compound interest on ₹5000 at 10% per annum for 2 years.
An article costing ₹200 is sold for ₹250. Find the profit percentage.
An article costing ₹460 is sold at a 25% profit. Find the selling price.
Find the average of the first five multiples of 6.
questions.explanation: Multiples: 6, 12, 18, 24, 30. Sum = 90. Average = 90/5 = 18.

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 5 : 7 and their sum is 48. Find the larger number.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 12. Each part = 48/12 = 4. Larger = 7 × 4 = 28.

questions.question: A train 100 m long crosses a pole in 5 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
A can do a work in 20 days and B in 5 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/20 + 1/5 = 25/100. Time = 100/25 = 4 days.

questions.question: Find the area of a circle with radius 21 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
Find the value of √361.
After a 25% discount, an item costs ₹600. Find its marked price.
Find 20% of 50% of 1900.
Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 5 and their difference is 10. Find the smaller number.
questions.explanation: Difference = 2 parts = 10, so each part = 5. Smaller = 3 × 5 = 15.

questions.question: A boat travels 18 km downstream in 2 hours. If the speed of the stream is 2 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 18/2 = 9 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 9 − 2 = 7 km/h.

questions.question: If today is Wednesday, what day will it be after 49 days?
questions.explanation: 49 mod 7 = 0; Wednesday + 0 = Wednesday.

questions.question: Which letter is 7th to the right of the 4th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 4th letter = D; 4 + 7 = 11th letter = K.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (3, 25), (7, 343), (5, 125), (2, 8)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 3³ = 27, not 25.

questions.question: In a row of 46 students, Ravi is 32nd from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 46 − 32 + 1 = 15.

questions.question: Find the next term: 49, 64, 81, 100, 121, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 7²…11². Next is 12² = 144.

questions.question: Find the next term: 5, 7, 12, 20, 31, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 3 each step; next difference is 14, so 31 + 14 = 45.

questions.question: If DOG is coded as FQI, how is BOOK coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 2. Applying the same to BOOK gives DQQM.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 1:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 1:00 the angle is 1 × 30° = 30°.
The relation is squaring: 10² = 100, so 6² = 36.

questions.question: A person walks 3 km East and then 4 km North. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(3² + 4²) = √25 = 5 km.

questions.question: If + means ×, and × means −, then evaluate: 4 + 4 × 2.
questions.explanation: Replace symbols: 4 × 4 − 2 = 16 − 2 = 14.

questions.question: Find the next term: 5, 16, 49, 148, ?
questions.explanation: Each term follows ×3 + 1: 148 × 3 + 1 = 445.

questions.question: Complete the series: D, H, L, P, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter advances by 4 places, so the next is T.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 3, 31, 6, 17
questions.explanation: 17, 31, 3 are prime numbers; 6 is a composite number.

questions.question: Which letter is 6th from the right end of the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: The 6th letter from the right is the 21st from the left = U.
